2. New Brand Launching
KIWAMIYA is an authentic Japanese Hamburg steak
and Wagyu grill restaurant brand, founded in 2010 in
Fukuoka, Japan, by Wahaha Co., Ltd. Renowned for its
signature rare-served Wagyu Hamburg and experiential
dining concept, KIWAMIYA has earned a loyal following
across Japan and is now expanding internationally.
In Thailand, KIWAMIYA is introduced through a strategic
licensing partnership with MAGURO Group, a leading
premium Japanese food brand operator. The first flagship
location is set to open at Central Park Bangkok in
September 2025.
BINCHO brings back the beauty of traditional
Japanese flavors.
Simple, soulful, and made for everyday life. Each dish is
grilled over Binchotan, a premium Japanese charcoal that
gently enhances every ingredient without overpowering.
At the heart of our space is an Irori いろり  — a traditional
open hearth that brings people together, just like in a
countryside home in Japan. We cook in the Robata Yaki ろ
ばたやき  style, a slow and thoughtful grilling method that
connects the cook and the guest. Our rice is freshly
cooked in small batches using Hagama はがま  pots,
served with nostalgic Japanese sides that complete the
harmony of flavor and feeling.

YOY: Q3’25 VS Q3’24
Gross profit was 247.3 million baht, increased by 78.2 million baht, representing an
increase of 46.3% mainly due to revenue contribution from new store openings, an
improved sales mix toward high-margin brand and products, effective cost control,
lower prices of certain key raw materials, and value chain optimization.
Gross profit margin in Q3’25 was 47.4%, remained at a level similar to that of
Q3’24, mainly due to effective cost control, lower prices of certain key raw materials,
and the continued implementation of Value Chain Optimization through flexible
menu development and an increased share of high-margin brands and products.
Gross profit was 664.4 million baht, increased by 224.3 million baht, representing an
increase of 51.0% mainly due to higher sales and service revenue driven by continued
network expansion, an improved sales mix, and stronger cost efficiency.
